items.text: Schwab reported Advisor Services segment client assets of $5,845.9 billion as of September 30, 2026.

cells.reason: Schwab does not disclose 'client assets per advisor' nor a financial-advisor headcount; the proxy's stand-in numerator (total client assets) is disclosed, and Schwab reports active brokerage accounts and independent RIA advisory firms rather than a count of employed financial advisors.
